title: ContestEvent
description: A specific year's dated occurrence of a template — just the calendar fact. Club-specific settings (which optional fields are shown, region weights, home location) are deliberately not here; those stay local to the importing instance.

id.description: Stable identifier, also the filename (events/<year>/<id>.json), e.g. "nhqp-2026".

name.description: Display name for the specific occurrence, e.g. "New Hampshire QSO Party 2026".

start_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC. For contests with a mid-event gap (e.g. NHQP's Saturday/Sunday split), this spans the full published window rather than modeling multiple sessions — the receiving app doesn't track session gaps either.

source_url.description: Where these dates were confirmed — required so a stale/wrong date is easy to double-check and fix.
